newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Oct aluminium imports up 9.6 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Oct aluminium imports up 9.6 pct y/y.

text.p: China's imports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials reached 529,853 tonnes in the first 10 months of 1996, up by 9.6 percent from a year-ago, the Futures Herald said on Monday, quoting customs figures.
Imports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials in October alone reached 53,125 tonnes.
China's imports of unwrought aluminium, including alloys, inched up 1.2 percent to 307,965 tonnes in the first 10 months compared with the year-ago period.
Imports of unrought aluminium were 28,475 tonnes in October alone.
Imports of alumina were 870,000 tonnes in the first 10 months, down 11.2 percent from the same period of last year. It was 50,000 tonnes in October alone.
China's exports of unwrought aluminium including alloys fell 54.8 percent to 75,750 tonnes in the first 10 months compared with the year-ago period.
Exports of unwrought aluminium, including alloys, were 10,037 tonnes in October alone.
